verdict.rationale: Crossplane ships an official CLI (docs and hands-on probe confirm install via brew and working `crossplane version --client`) supporting building/testing/rendering Compositions and managing packages, but it is not framed or evidenced as an AI-native/agentic interface (no MCP integration, no agent-friendly output modes, no natural-language or automation-specific tooling beyond generic CLI usage). missing for 10: explicit AI-native design/marketing for the CLI itself, evidence of agent-friendly structured output or automation hooks, and independent corroboration beyond one hands-on probe.
